question.text: Based on the knowledge of consumer rights protection learned from the conversation, Nina received a sweater with a hole and discovered the quality issue on the third day after receiving the goods. What rights does she have under the law, and what is the legal basis?

questions.original_answer: Nina is legally entitled to request a return and refund. According to Article 24 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law, if a product has quality issues, consumers may directly request a return and refund within seven days of receiving the goods. Since the sweater has a hole, which constitutes a quality issue, and this falls within the seven-day period, Nina has the right to demand a refund from the merchant.
